Section Name:BILLS
Title:FINANCIAL PROCEDURE BILL
MPs Speaking:Dr Goh Keng Swee (Minister for Finance); Mr K. M. Byrne (Minister for Labour and Law); Mr Lee Kuan Yew (Prime Minister); Mr Ong Eng Guan (Minister for National Development); Inche Mohd. Ali Bin Alwi; Mr A. P. Rajah; Mr S. T. Bani; Sir George Oehlers (Mr Speaker);


Column: 21

BILLS INTRODUCED

FINANCIAL PROCEDURE BILL
First Reading


10.03 a.m.

    The Minister for Finance (Dr Goh Keng Swee): Mr Speaker, I beg to introduce a Bill intituled "An Ordinance to provide for the control and management of the public finances of the State of Singapore, and for financial and accounting procedure, including procedure for the collection, custody and payment of the public moneys of the State of Singapore, and the purchase, custody and disposal of public property, other than land, of the State of Singapore and for matters connected therewith."

    The Chairman: May I just look at the amendments?

    +The following amendments stood in the name of Mr David Marshall:

    (1) In page 3, line 1, leave out "two".

11.00 a.m.
